notes: depends on #210 | IN PROGRESS 2026-08-03 by claude-code - one systemic defect class closed, sweep not finished. FIXED: UTC/local calendar-date confusion across all three frontends. 14 call sites built a YYYY-MM-DD calendar date via new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10), which converts to UTC before slicing - so in IST (UTC+05:30) every one of them returned YESTERDAY for any local time before 05:30. Customer-facing impact was real booking correctness, not cosmetics: SlotPicker's 7-day strip started a day early, and the booking summary, reschedule and recurring-booking screens all defaulted the customer to yesterday's date for the first five and a half hours of every day. Admin impact was date-range filter defaults (dashboard, reports, nestly-coins) and coupon validity defaults being off by one, plus CSV export filenames stamped with the wrong day. Fixed by adding lib/date.ts (toLocalIsoDate / todayIsoDate / isoDateOffsetFromToday), replicated to all three apps, and routing every call site through it; the offset helper uses setDate rather than subtracting 30*24h in milliseconds so it also stays correct across a DST transition, where a day is not 24 hours. Verified by grep that no toISOString-derived calendar date remains anywhere in the three src trees, and npm run build exit 0 on all three.
